name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Orders and kitchen for a food truck
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from overload and keep working when the connection drops. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for a food truck: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen will manage to cook, then mark the order ready and handed over.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU WON’T MAKE
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how much time it takes. When a collection time is taken, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capacity.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE WINDOW
Add on-the-spot orders on the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to cook now, what’s next and what’s already ready, and warns you when it’s time to start an order.

ORDER TICKET PRINTING
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or through the local network, and order tickets will print automatically.

KEEP WORKING EVEN WHEN THE CONNECTION DROPS
Switch on protection against connection loss: if the connection drops, pre-orders pause, and nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders taken on the device are kept and synced when the connection returns.

MADE FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Work on iPhone or iPad. The screen stays on during service, notifications tell you when an order needs confirming, and the app can be locked with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and locations once and take orders for each of them.

HatchGrab is made for food truck owners and their staff. To sign in you need a HatchGrab account.
whatsNew:
HatchGrab now supports 60 languages.

Print order tickets on a kitchen printer on your local network, as well as over Bluetooth.

Bug fixes and improvements.
shortDescription: Pre-orders at food trucks, choice of collection time and a kitchen screen.
